requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: API key for the AI that reads each quote and donor priority pair: the worker's filter drops pairs that share only topic words or take opposing positions, and the discovery judge confirms the embedding shortlist.

requirements.name: DATABASE_URL
requirements.description: Connection to the Postgres database that holds every record of the pairing site: transcripts, donors' priorities, campaign finance rows, pairings, dropped pairs, the audit log and the worker's progress. Production's value is the project's own database.
requirements.instructions: Create a Postgres database for the site and an account the site connects as. For example, as a superuser: CREATE ROLE app LOGIN PASSWORD '<a long random password>'; CREATE DATABASE app OWNER app; then ALTER ROLE app CREATEDB; so that the account app may also create, change and drop databases whose names begin with the literal prefix mendel_sandbox_ (the underscores are literal) and nothing else beyond its own database app; it owns only what it creates, so it cannot touch other databases. Put the connection in the form postgresql://app:<password>@<host>:5432/app. The site applies its own migrations when it starts.

datastore.capacity_basis: About ten Board and committee transcripts of roughly 150 KB each are stored a week (about 80 MB a year), plus a few MB of campaign finance rows refreshed weekly and a few hundred cards, dropped pairs and log rows, so a year stays well under 1 GB and 2 GB leaves headroom.

requirements.name: DATASF_APP_TOKEN
requirements.description: Optional DataSF app token; the campaign finance queries send it to lift the anonymous rate limit and work the same without it.

requirements.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
requirements.description: The secret the site's maintainer enters to sign in to the review queue and priority form.

requirements.name: FETCH_CONTACT_EMAIL
requirements.description: The contact email put in the user agent of the site's fetching, so the sources can reach the maintainer.
